organization.fullName: Alliance for Clinical Trials in Oncology

identificationModule.briefTitle: Aspirin in Preventing Recurrence of Cancer in Patients With HER2 Negative Stage II-III Breast Cancer After Chemotherapy, Surgery, and/or Radiation Therapy
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized Phase III Double Blinded Placebo Controlled Trial of Aspirin as Adjuvant Therapy for HER2 Negative Breast Cancer: The ABC Trial

armGroups.label: Arm I (aspirin)
armGroups.description: Patients receive aspirin PO QD for five years in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

armGroups.label: Arm II (Placebo)
armGroups.description: Patients receive placebo PO QD for five years in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.
